target.title: fix: route direct outbound polls through channel adapters
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where core poll sends for direct channel plugins still went through the message gateway path, so agent/channel poll fallback could fail or misroute even when the selected channel exposed `outbound.sendPoll` directly.

AI-assisted: yes.

## Why This Change Was Made

`sendPoll` now follows the same delivery-mode split as message sends: direct and hybrid outbound adapters use the plugin `sendPoll` fallback with existing target resolution, while gateway-mode adapters keep using the gateway poll RPC. The shared poll path also preserves the existing duration/anonymity support gates, and CLI formatting now reports direct core polls as direct deliveries instead of gateway deliveries.

## User Impact

Agents and CLI message actions can send polls through direct-capable channel plugins without requiring gateway poll routing, while unsupported poll options still fail clearly instead of being silently ignored.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/message-format.test.ts src/infra/outbound/format.test.ts src/infra/outbound/message.channels.test.ts src/infra/outbound/outbound-send-service.test.ts src/infra/outbound/message-action-runner.poll.test.ts`
- `pnpm tsgo:test:src`
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` -> clean, no accepted/actionable findings
